blocking_findings.title: Non-SS precheck dependency closure is not held; reference pins are rebound
blocking_findings.evidence: refs omits check.dependency_snapshot.files, owner evidence, and original_capture_ref returned by actual_audit. recheck_inputs verifies once before archive writes; unheld dependencies can change before SS replace. The comprehension recomputes pin after checked instead of retaining expected input SHA.
blocking_findings.impact: SS can append an ACCEPTED row after the evidence or Source used by the PASS precheck has drifted. Holding a newly observed hash can conceal a changed expected reference.
minimal_fix: Build a canonical-identity map from exact expected refs, reject conflicting aliases or different SHA for the same file.
Add every dependency_snapshot.files entry except exactly canonical step_state.json, with the recorded SHA and an observed size only after matching that SHA.
Add owner evidence and the actual_audit returned immutable capture refs. Preserve supplied expected digests; do not replace them with fresh pin values.
Hold all these non-SS files through validation, archive, atomic replacement and committed receipt; verify approval/audit/precheck after acquire.
Keep snapshot audit_ranges/inventories validation immediately before commit; validate finite original ranges without deny-write locking the entire actively growing Root audit log.
If closure exceeds guard caps, report a concrete resource-boundary issue; do not silently omit dependencies.

blocking_findings.title: Original atomic/lock functions are bound to a weaker path resolver
blocking_findings.evidence: The extracted functions use injected local path_in, which resolves links with strict=True and only checks repo containment. Original path_in rejects absolute/drive/traversal/symlink/junction and does not resolve SS into another target.
blocking_findings.impact: An in-repo linked step_state path can cause atomic_state to replace the resolved different repo file while the receipt claims only_SS_written. A missing original lock also fails strict resolve before writer_lock can create it.
minimal_fix: AST-extract original path_in with Path/PureWindowsPath, Refusal/need, sha and exclusive dependency closure; keep exact original STATE/SCOPE_DIR.
Alternatively use a separately reviewed equivalent that preserves all original path/link checks; do not call the two function AST bodies exact behavioral reuse while weakening their dependencies.
Resolve and verify canonical repo once; validate Root output ancestry link-free and same-volume before invoking these primitives.

positive_checks.detail: Exact base SHA is checked; actual AST FunctionDef nodes atomic_state/writer_lock are selected and compiled, retaining writer_lock decorator. This does not validate substituted globals.
SCOPE_DIR spells the original W04 serial-writer lock directory; no new W09 lock.
Exact prospective owner refs and designated actors/statuses are compared to approval and Main precheck.
Pinned actual_audit authenticates original Root/peer three-record delivery and approval hash; returned immutable capture refs must also be held.
Exact current4 order/refs, lock-scoped current reread and full SS expected SHA precede atomic replacement.
Rejects existing W09-99; deep copy + append + pop inverse preserves old parsed rows/order/top-level metadata. This is semantic preservation, not original serialized layout.

Raw original, desired and immutable intent use xb/fsync before atomic replace. Archive original is local, intent before_ref points canonical location plus old SHA; adding the explicit archive ref improves recovery clarity.
No recover or rollback path is invoked. Committed receipt explicitly leaves formal derivation pending. Root postderive failure must retain SS truth and receipts.

additional_observations.detail: Use original strict/encoded helpers (including math dependency and allow_nan=False) or equivalent for new Root helper. json.loads can collapse duplicate keys; inverse proves preservation only after parsing. Actual canonical precheck should retain its strict validation.

This helper has no except block recording failed stage/current hash; guard-close persistence may mask an earlier exception. Root outer caller must preserve original tool exception/result and current SS classification, with no autoRollback. New failure journaling is preferable but must not overwrite the original error.
No request, approval or precheck execution was replayed. The report evaluates fixed Source bytes and pinned dependency implementations, not a future append or actual postderive result.

re_review_scope: Only changed dependency closure and primitive path binding plus their exact new Source pin; do not replay successful W09 formal review or Native.
